cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Make Help Define Us
cards.instruction: Get their help, then use how it is offered to redefine what the relationship means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Carry the table with me, not for me. I'd like us to be partners today. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm stronger. I can do it alone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. That's the arrangement I'm trying to stop calling our friendship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Now ask where we're putting it instead of deciding for both ends.

mechanism: A directs a joint move but needs B to carry it jointly so their friendship can become a partnership.
confusable: Generic dependence lacks the demand that the manner of help change their relationship.
comparison: The other alternative negotiates written credit instead of physical work and equality between friends.
seedUse: The table seed supplies the strong joint-help conflict; the shift-leader seed suggests adjusting a command to secure cooperation.
